# HubHum — A Git Hub for Humans

> Plain-English, verified directory of free and open-source software explained without developer jargon, pointing strictly to official GitHub releases and upstream creator channels.

Catalog Size: 1250 open-source tools (Tier 1 GUI: 625, Tier 2 Web/Self-Hosted: 375, Tier 3 Power Tools: 250 | 625 Desktop GUI, 374 Self-Hosted, 1 Web Apps, 240 CLI/Power Tools, 10 Open References) | 70 Topic Cluster Guides across 6 Pillars | 6 Curated Bundles.

## Primary Endpoints
- [Homepage & Interactive Catalog](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/): Search and filter free software by format, OS, and everyday task
- [Compact Single-File RAG Digest](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/catalog-rag.txt): Full hierarchical taxonomy, guides, and 2-line app summaries for AI retrieval
- [Architecture & Codebase Context Map](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/codebase-full.txt): Complete site map, API endpoints, topic tree, and full catalog reference
- [Full Plain-English Software Digest (RAG)](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/llms-full.txt): Structured index of every app summarized by category
- [OpenAPI 3.0 Spec](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/api/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI definition for public HubHum endpoints ([Swagger JSON](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/api/swagger.json))
- [AI Plugin Manifest](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): Standard agent discovery manifest
- [Open JSON Catalog API](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/api/catalog.json): Machine-readable metadata for all 1250 software cards
- [Topic Clusters & Bundles JSON API](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/api/clusters.json): Hierarchical topic guide tree and curated starter bundles
- [RSS Feed](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/feed.xml): Latest indexed software guides and category comparisons
- [About & Editorial Transparency](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/about/): Methodology, official link verification policy, and #ad isolation
